map.输入衰变常数 λ 与经过时间 t，按 f = 1 − e^{−λt} 计算已衰变: Enter the decay constant λ and elapsed time t and compute the decayed fraction of nuclei with f = 1 − e^{−λt}, assessing how far a source has decayed and its remaining activity.
map.输入衰变常数 λ 与时间 t，求已衰变份额。: Enter the decay constant λ and time t to get the decayed fraction.
map.f = 1 − e^(−λt) 求经时间 t 已衰变比例。: f = 1 − e^(−λt) gives the fraction decayed after time t.
map.辐照、储存时间设计。: Design for irradiation and storage time.
map.对比不同 λt 的衰变程度。: Compare the degree of decay at different λt.
map.：当 t=1/λ 时 f=1−e⁻¹≈63.2%，即平均寿命内约 2/3 衰变。: : when t=1/λ, f=1−e⁻¹≈63.2%, i.e. about 2/3 decays within one mean life.
map.由吸收剂量与品质因数求剂量当量: Dose equivalent from absorbed dose and quality factor
map.由物理与生物半衰期求有效半衰期: Effective half-life from physical and biological half-lives

map.衰变份额与存活概率关系？: What is the relationship between decayed fraction and survival probability?
map.存活概率 P=e^(−λt)，衰变份额 f=1−P，二者互补，见 surviva: Survival probability P=e^(−λt), decayed fraction f=1−P; the two are complementary — see survival-probability.
map.此时约 63.2% 衰变，是衰变速率的常用参考点。: At this point about 63.2% has decayed — a common reference point for decay rates.
